tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dbang bshad lung dang man ngag gi gter mdzod kyi dbang gsum pa'i skabs kyi mi gsal ba gsal bar byed pa'i legs bshad zab don rgyas pa'i thabs mchog ces bya ba bzhugs so// na maḥshrī mansaṅgu rushtsa dhi de ba te ye/ 'dir legs par smras pa bya ba 'di lta ste/ rdo rje 'chang dkon mchog lhun grub kyi dbang bshad lung dang man ngag gi gter mdzod kyi dbang gsum pa'i skabs su/ dbang gsum pa de la sku gsum gyi dbang tshang tshul bstan nas/ de'i rjes de ma thag pa la/ de nyid la ye shes lnga'i dbang / phyag rgya ma lnga'i dbang / he ru ka bcu gcig gi dbang / de kho na nyid nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i dbang / phyag rgya dang / dkyil 'khor dang / sngags kyi de kho na nyid kyi dbang ste phyag rgya la brten nas ye shes dga' bzhi'i dbang rnams thob bo/ /zhes gsungs pa de dag ni dbang gsum pa de la yon tan gyi ldog pa'i sgo nas bzhag pa yin te/ de yang sku gsum gyi dbang tshang tshul ni/ dbang bshad rang na gsal bar bzhugs pas 'dir ma bkod la/ der mi gsal ba rnams 'dir bshad par bya'o/ /de la ye shes lnga dbang tshang tshul ni/ phyag rgya rnam gnyis la brten nas/ /lhan skyes bde stong rtogs pa'i tshe/ /chos kun skye med ngo bor gsal/ /de ni me long ye shes yin/ /de tshe 'khor 'das mnyam nyid du/ /rtogs pas mnyam pa nyid ye shes/ /rlung brtan nus pa thig le nyid/ /mi 'chor tshor ba bde ba ches/ /tshim pa sor rtog ye shes so/ /de kho na nyid rang nyid las/ /grub pa bya grub ye shes te/ /mi rtog don gyis chos dbyings kyi/ /ye shes yin phyir ye shes lnga/ /tshang ba'i tshul ni de ltar yin/ /de bzhin du phyag rgya ma lnga'i dbang tshang tshul ni/ rig ma las byung lhan skyes kyi/ /ye shes ches des mtshan rtog la/ /phar mi reg pas bram ze mo/ /mtshan rtog dag gis lhan skyes la/ /tshur mi reg pas g.yung mo ste/ /bdag gi rgyud de bde chen du/

/bsgyur phyir gar ma gzhan dag kyang / /bde bar bsgyur bas chos ma'o/ /mtshan rtog gsod phyir gtum mo ste/ /de phyir phyag rgya ma lnga tshang / /he ru ka bcu gcig gi dbang tshang tshul ni/ phyag rgya ma la brten pa yis/ /bde chen lhan skyes rtogs pa'i ngor/ /cir snang gzugs rnams bde stong gi /ngo bo kho nar legs par 'char/ /de ni gzugs kyi he ru ka /de bzhin sgra dang dri dang ro/ /reg bya chos kyi snang ba'i tshogs/ /gang shar thams cad bde stong gis/ /ngo bor 'char ba nyid kyi phyir/ /sgra dang dri ro reg bya dang / /chos kyi he ru ka ste lnga/ /bdag nyid lhar bskyed bde stong du/ /'char ba dam tshig he ru ka /de la bde stong ngo bo yi/ /ye shes pa nyid bzhugs pa gzhan/ /ye shes he ru ka zhes bya/ /bris sku lugs sku la sogs pa'i/ /he ru ka yi sku thams cad/ /bde stong ngo bor 'char ba des/ /btags pa brda yi he ru ka /shrī he ru ka dang ni/ /badzra he ru ka la sogs/ /he ru ka yi ming btags pa/ /thams cad bde stong du 'char ba/ /ming gi he ru ka zhes bshad/ /shrī ni gnyis med ye shes te/ /he ni rgyu sogs stong pa nyid/ /ru ni tshogs dang bral ba ste/ /ka ni gang du'ang mi gnas pa'o/ /zhes pa'i yi ge bzhi yi don/ /rnam thar sgo gsum mngon gyur pas/ /spros bral stong pa nyid de ni/ /don gyi ye shes kyi he ru/ /ka ste hai ru ka bcu gcig /tshang ba'i tshul ni de ltar yin/ /de kho na nyid nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i dbang tshang tshul ni/ sku gsum dang ni ye shes lnga/ /phyag rgya lnga dang he ru ka /bcu gcig po ste nyer bzhi po/ /de dag bdag gi lus la ni/ /gnas shing byin rlobs bde ba la/ /rol pa'i don gyi phyir na lha/ /yin te des na lha yi ni/ /de kho na nyid nyer bzhi'i dbang / /tshang ba'i rgyu mtshan de ltar lags/ /phyag rgya dang / dkyil 'khor dang / sngags kyi de kho na nyid kyi dbang tshang tshul ni/

phyag rgya ma las byung ba yi/ /bde chen lhan skyes kyi nyams dang / /ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pa yis ni/ /lag pa ci bsgyur phyag rgyar 'gyur/ /de ni phyag rgya'i de kho na/ /nyid kyi dbang yin rkang pa yis/ /ci byas thams cad dkyil 'khor du/ /'gyur bas dkyil 'khor de kho na/ /nyid kyi dbang yin ngag gis ci/ /brjod pa sngags su 'gyur ba na/ /sngags kyang de kho na nyid kyi/ /dbang ste des na phyag rgya dang / /dkyil 'khor sngags kyi de kho na/ /nyid kyi dbang rnams tshang ba'i tshul/ /de ltar bshad pa de bzhin no/ /legs par bshad pa de rnams rtsa ba gang las 'phros she na/ bstan bcos chen po rdo rje'i tshig rkang las/ sku gsum ye shes lnga sogs dbang thob nas/ /zhes gsungs pa de nyid las 'phros pa'o/ /'dir smras pa/ dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi bgrod gcig lam/ /'jigs bral dpal ldan chos skyong bzhed pa'i srol/ /sa skya'i rje btsun rnams kyis legs bshad pa'i/ /brjod don rtogs pa deng sang kho bo tsam/ /'dir bshad zab don rnams kyi don 'di zhes/ /mkhas shing mkhas par grags pa 'ga' zhig gis/ /smra bar ma nus de phyir rnam dpyod kyi/ /blo gros mtshungs med bdag gis tshul 'di sbyar/ /'on kyang zab don gsal bar bshad pa la/ /nyes pa mchis na bla ma mkha' 'gror bshags/ /dge ba zab don don gnyer skye bo la/ /'phral dang yun du phan pa 'byung gyur cig /ces dbang bshad lung dang man ngag gi gter mdzod kyi dbang gsum pa'i skabs kyi mi gsal ba gsal bar byed pa'i legs bshad zab don rgyas pa'i thabs mchog ces bya ba 'di ni/ khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bor gyur pa rje btsun mus pa chen po sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan zhes yongs la grags pa'i skyabs gnas kun 'dus de nyid kyi thugs rje'i spyan ras kyis 'tsho zhing gsung gi bdud rtsi'i skal ba bzang por gyur pa shrī sa skya pa shākya'i btsun pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/

rje sa skya pa chen pos mdzad pa'i gzhung bshad rnams dang / dmar chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa'i gzhung bshad dang / bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos mdzad pa'i gzhung bshad man ngag gi mdzod ces bya ba la/ chos rje dpal ldan tshul khrims kyis gsal byed kyi mchan dang bcas pa de rnams la brten nas me pho 'brug gi lo rgyal gyi zla ba'i nyer bzhi'i nyin bla brang phun tshogs gling gi thos bsam 'brug sgra tshal gyi rang byung bsam gtan khang bur sbyar ba'o/ /sarba maṅga laṃ/ kalya na wardhantu// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 a myes zhabs/ dbang gsum pa'i skabs kyi mi gsal ba gsal bar byed pa'i legs bshad/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 3
